phase1_leaf_result.part105_scope: Bounded official-GitHub audit of global node IDs, issue-comment IDs and repository IDs as default service-side rollback witnesses; issue/release deletion-retention was not generalized beyond retrieved evidence.
phase1_leaf_result.new_falsification: Unique GitHub object IDs are not sufficient monotonic generation witnesses: global IDs are documented opaque; tested comment markers are deletable and separately committed; repository IDs discriminate repository objects but do not witness same-repository content/history ABA and are not an expected precondition on the tested contents CAS write.
phase1_leaf_result.minimal_unresolved_child: A default service-side append-only-looking object that survives branch/history rollback, is not erasable by ordinary authority, and can be atomically coupled to or safely reconciled with repository-local CAS publication without settings/protected/manual execution.

phase1_acceptance.scope_guard: Only the official GitHub global-node-ID, issue-comment and repository-delete documentation plus the current Chat contents-update capability surface used in Part105; issue/release deletion persistence and unaudited GitHub object classes remain unresolved.

continuation: Part106: execute one bounded public-source leaf on GitHub commit-status objects as the next default service-side witness class. Audit whether status records are append-only/non-deletable under ordinary repository authority, their ID/order and retention semantics after ref/history rewrite, discoverability when the target commit is no longer referenced, and exact write/read permissions. Test dual-write ambiguity between contents CAS publication and status creation; accept only if recovery proves one logical generation without richer-mode/protected/manual execution, finite monthly/trial/paid quota or extra cost. If commit statuses fail, persist the next service-side append-only candidate class without executing it in the same invocation.
